title: Release flow command walkthrough
notes: Session dominated by shell commands. Tests command-type atom recall and whether multi-step command sequences are captured faithfully.

turns.text: I keep forgetting the right commands for this repo's release flow. Can you write them down as we go through a release?
Sure. Step 1, run the full test suite: bun run test. Step 2, build: bun run build. Step 3, validate contracts: bun run contracts:validate.

Not quite — first bump the version and tag: npm version 0.9.0 --no-git-tag-version then git tag v0.9.0 && git push origin v0.9.0. The version-tag-parity CI gate checks package.json.version matches the pushed tag, so they have to move together in the same PR.
npm publish --access public once CI is green on the tag.
What about rolling back if publish goes wrong?
npm deprecate @astragenie/astramemory-local@0.9.0 "broken release, use 0.8.1" — npm doesn't support unpublishing after 72 hours, so deprecate-and-reissue is the real rollback path.

gold_atoms.text: npm version 0.9.0 --no-git-tag-version && git tag v0.9.0 && git push origin v0.9.0
The version-tag-parity CI gate checks that package.json's version matches the pushed git tag, so both must move together in the same PR.
npm does not support unpublishing a package after 72 hours, so deprecate-and-reissue is the real rollback path for a broken release.
